answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 18849 Country: India Title: Is bathing between two intercourses necessary? Question: Asslamualikum Mufti Sahib. Mufti sahib kya iek var apni biwi se intercourse karne ke baad Ghusal karna jaruri hai. Aur agar Ghusal nhi kya aur dubara intercourse kya aur use nutfe se biwi hamla ho jati ha kya vo bacha Halal Hai ya Haram. Answer ID: 18849 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 77/77=M=1431) It is mustahab to perform ghusl between two subsequent intercourses. If one had intercourse without having bath and his wife was conceived, the baby shall be legitimate, but doing so is not better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
